card.name: Mystery
card.effect: Choose exactly one Mystery: Ancestor, Battle, Bones, Cataclysm, Dream, Flame, Life, Shadow, Stars or Time. It determines your Prophecy Trigger, level-1 Mystery identity, Revelation choices, Mystic Insight, Revelation Mastery options, Prophetic Surge variant and Final Revelation. The Mystery cards below define those features.

card.name: Prophetic Insight
card.duration: Until end of your next regular turn or until used
card.effect: Glimpse several immediate possibilities. Gain advantage on your next attack roll, saving throw or ability check before the end of your next regular turn. You must choose which roll receives the advantage before rolling it. This grants no knowledge of another player's future choice.

originalObjects.value: Prophetic Insight — brief glimpse of possible futures; advantage on next action

card.name: Mystic Insight
card.effect: Gain the Mystic Insight printed for your selected Mystery in the Mystery cards below. If that Mystery presents multiple Minor Revelation/passive choices, choose exactly one as specified there.

value.feature: Mystic Insight — minor Revelation or passive from your Mystery

card.name: Haunted — Boon III
card.rangeAndTarget: Self and up to three allies within 15 feet
card.effect: while conscious, you and allies within 15 feet cannot be Surprised; such allies gain +2 on Insight checks.

value.name: Haunted
value.blurb: Restless dead attend your steps, offering aid at a social cost
limitations: Restless spirits draw attention: you suffer −2 to Stealth in haunted places or crowded civilized areas
Spirits sometimes speak through you at inopportune moments; social checks may require a Wisdom save
You sometimes address people who are not yet present, unsettling those who witness it

boons.name: Curse Boon I
boons.description: Spectral attendants grant +1 AC against the first attack each round. Once per day, a spirit whispers a warning — you cannot be surprised.

boons.name: Curse Boon II
boons.description: Once per combat, a bound spirit intercepts a single-target attack against you, absorbing up to 5 + level damage before dissipating. The spirit wails as it fades — the attacker must save or suffer −2 to their next attack as dread clings to them.

boons.name: Curse Boon III
boons.description: Spirits murmur of danger — you and allies within 3 tiles cannot be surprised while you are conscious. Echoes of the dead grant +2 to Insight checks nearby.

boons.name: Curse Boon IV
boons.description: Summon a wailing chorus: enemies within 3 tiles suffer Dread (−10% hit chance and saves) for 2 turns. Once per long rest.

boons.name: Curse Boon V
boons.description: Once per day, bind a hostile or friendly spirit to scout, speak with the dead at a distance, or deliver a prophetic message along a path you have walked. The spirit persists for 10 minutes or until it completes one task; when it returns, it whispers what it saw and one name you did not send it to find.

card.name: Haunted — Boon V
card.rangeAndTarget: One spirit scout; one-mile same-plane route limit
card.effect: 1/long rest summon one spirit scout for 10 minutes. On return it truthfully reports what it directly observed and may identify one unexpected creature or person's name it actually encountered. It cannot pass sealed planar barriers, read minds or reveal unknowable facts.

card.name: Tongues
card.effect: LIMITATIONS: unless you suppress the chorus, take -2 on social checks with mortals who do not understand your overlapping speech. You may suppress it as an Action for 10 minutes; while suppressed you cannot use Tongues Boons requiring supernatural speech. Prophetic statements may be misunderstood narratively but the Director should not falsify player intent. boons.description: Once per day, speak a single Word in the tongue of creation — all who hear must save or obey one short command. Those who resist take psychic damage.

card.name: False Life
card.effect: LIMITATIONS: divination treats you as undead unless it specifically pierces Oracle curses. Before a healing spell from another creature restores HP to you, its caster may make Wisdom (Insight) against your Revelation save DC. On success healing works normally. On failure roll d2; on 1 the spell restores 0 HP to you but still expends its normal costs. Non-spell healing is unaffected. Social hesitation from life-focused clergy remains narrative unless the scene calls for an ordinary reaction check.

value.name: False Life
value.blurb: Magic mistakes your living breath for death and answers accordingly
limitations: Healing spells cast on you without a successful Insight check have a 50% chance to fail; magic reads you as corpse-cold
Unless you suppress the curse, divination treats you as undead
Clerics of life-deities may hesitate to aid you without proof that you still breathe

boons.name: Curse Boon I
boons.description: Advantage on saves vs death effects and negative energy. Once per long rest, when you would die, stabilize at 1 HP as your body feigns death perfectly.

boons.name: Curse Boon II
boons.description: Feign death perfectly for 1 minute — undead ignore you unless attacked; you remain conscious but motionless. Once per combat.

boons.name: Curse Boon III
boons.description: When reduced to 0 HP, remain conscious for 1 round before falling — you may move, speak, or cast one Revelation. Once per long rest.

boons.name: Curse Boon IV
boons.description: Necrotic resilience: +10% DR vs necrotic and negative energy. Undead attackers have 10% chance to miss you entirely, sensing kinship.

boons.name: Curse Boon V
boons.description: Once per day, return from death's threshold — after 1 round of appearing dead at 0 HP, rise at 25% max HP with immunity to necrotic for 2 rounds. Undead within 3 tiles treat you as kin until you act, and divination cast during your feigned death returns false results of your choosing.

card.effect: Gain advantage on History checks and you cannot be Surprised while conscious. Once per long rest, spend 1 minute consulting your ancestors about one specific person, place, object or course of action. The Director provides one truthful cryptic clue drawn from knowledge the ancestral spirits could reasonably possess; they do not reveal unknowable future decisions.

value.name: Ancestral Whispers
value.description: Advantage on History checks and immunity to surprise. Once per day, consult ancestors for cryptic but useful guidance.

card.name: Echo Crowned
card.cost: 0 RC to maintain spirits; Revelation costs normally unless stated
card.rangeAndTarget: Self; death prevention ally within 5 tiles
card.frequency: Double-cast 1/long rest; each spirit may be sacrificed once per long rest
card.effect: Maintain three named ancestral Echoes: Offense grants +1 on your first Revelation attack each round; Defense reduces the first damage you take each round by S; Utility grants advantage on one History, Insight or Perception check per round. Once per long rest, when you activate a known Revelation, you may pay its RC cost twice and resolve it twice as part of the same action against different legal targets; copied resolution cannot duplicate resource or action triggers. You may sacrifice one currently available Echo as a Reaction when an ally within 5 tiles would be reduced to 0 HP to leave that ally at 1 HP instead, or as a Bonus Action to restore your RC to maximum. A sacrificed Echo provides no passive benefit until your next long rest.

value.name: Echo Crowned
value.description: Maintain 3 passive ancestral spirits (offense, defense, utility). Once per day, cast any Revelation twice in one turn using different Echoes. Sacrifice an Echo to prevent a party member's death or restore all Revelation Charges.

card.name: Battle-Seer's Eye

card.effect: Gain advantage on Perception and initiative rolls. value.name: Battle-Seer's Eye
value.description: Advantage on Perception and Initiative. Once per day, foretell an enemy's opening strike — you and one ally gain +2 AC against that enemy's next attack.

card.name: Ledger's Memory
card.effect: Gain advantage on checks to identify undead, poison and disease. Once per long rest, touch one corpse and learn its identity if the Pale Ledger could reasonably know it, its approximate time of death and the direct physical or magical cause of death. This does not reveal the killer's identity unless the corpse or supernatural Ledger actually knows it.

value.name: Ledger's Memory
value.description: Advantage on checks to identify undead, poison, and disease. Once per day, consult the Pale Ledger for the name and cause of death of any corpse you touch.

card.name: Wound of Creation

Once per long rest spend an Action to sense the nearest significant structural weak point, unstable surface, hidden fracture or likely collapse point within 10 tiles that is physically connected to your surroundings. You learn direction and broad nature, not an automatic method to destroy it.

value.name: Wound of Creation
value.description: Advantage on checks involving geology, storms, or the Descent's unstable floors. Once per day, sense the nearest structural weak point within 10 tiles.

value.name: Lucid Oracle
value.description: Advantage on saves vs sleep and illusion. Once per day, ask the Veiled Threshold one question — receive a symbolic but truthful vision.

value.name: Founder's Memory
value.description: Advantage on History checks involving Tyrnathar and the Tenfold Cycles. Once per day, invoke the Crown's memory to reroll a failed save vs fire or fear.

Once per long rest, examine one willing creature for 1 minute and learn the broad nature of one disease, poison, curse-like affliction or bodily condition affecting it plus one plausible mundane, magical or quest-based countermeasure known to the Verdant Resonance. This identifies rather than automatically cures the condition.

value.name: Bloom Oracle
value.description: Advantage on Medicine and Nature. Once per day, diagnose any affliction by touch and learn one countermeasure the Verdant Resonance suggests.

card.frequency: Skill benefits always; fear reading 1/long rest
card.effect: Gain advantage on Stealth and Insight checks. Once per long rest choose one creature within 3 tiles and spend an Action reading its surface fear. If the creature is not protected from mind-reading or divination, the Director truthfully identifies one present fear, dread or aversion known to that creature. value.name: Shadow Oracle

value.name: Stellar Oracle

The Director answers yes, no or unclear and provides one cryptic truthful hint. This does not reveal player choices or guarantee a deterministic future.

value.name: Spiral Oracle

card.effect: While affected, a marked creature cannot voluntarily teleport, become invisible or enter extradimensional travel.
